rejected_rule.statement: A person can only transfer interests he himself had over a particular land before such land was deemed vested in the Commission.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: As such, I am in agreement with the Appellant’s contention that co-ownership with respect to Mattegoda Muakalana has not been terminated by virtue of any provisions of the Land Reforms Law. 41. As such, I am in agreement with the Appellant’s contention that co-ownership with respect to Mattegoda Muakalana has not been terminated by virtue of any provisions of the Land Reforms Law. Under an inter-family transfer in terms of Section 14 of the Law, a person can only transfer such interests he himself had over a particular land before such land was deemed vested in the Commission.
rejected_rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 14 of the Land Reform Law
